exposure: Fetal head position (occiput anterior vs. non-occiput anterior)
cohort: Nulliparous women at term with prolonged second stage of labor
finding: Ultrasound measured head-perineum distance was predictive of labor outcomes, including duration of vacuum extraction and mode of delivery, in nulliparous women with prolonged second stage of labor.
mod_finding: Duration of vacuum extraction was shorter in women with head-perineum distance ≤25 mm, and head-perineum distance was associated with both spontaneous delivery and cesarean delivery.
